entities.summary: Jean-Baptiste Robinet, also known as Jean-Baptiste-René Robinet, was a French naturalist, known for his five-volume work De la nature (1761–68). He was also involved in the sequel publications to the Encyclopédie, took on Diderot's editorial role, and was a translator of numerous works to the French language.
